5843.title: Resident turns discard updated dynamic-tool definitions
5843.rootCauseOneLine: Resident turn submission drops fresh dynamicTools before the runtime; Claude already refreshes changed construction settings on explicit resume.
5843.proposedFix: Refresh resident construction-scoped tools at the daemon/runtime boundary and reuse Claude's existing resume comparison while preserving conversation identity.
5843.caveats: Exact macOS plugin-reload race and real Claude tool-search behavior unverified; SDK query mocked. Two clean runs agree. No PR because a safe repair spans daemon/runtime lifecycle subsystems.
